note: When no trait is available, the loader converts a one-item DeferredConfigList to a DeferredConfigString after expanding the path.
DeferredConfigList selects trait.from_string_list whenever the trait supplies it, passing the items as a list.
DeferredConfigString.get_value passes a plain string to trait.from_string.
The container’s scalar parser tries literal_eval and passes None to validation if evaluation raises an exception.
